description: List every object that lies on the pasteboard (Montageflaeche) beside the pages, per spread – so that leftovers show up before printing or packaging. Objects that touch a page count as on the page and are not listed. include_parent_pages true also checks the parent spreads (Musterseiten). Per spread: spread_id, spread_index, is_parent_spread, page_names[], item_count and items[] {item_id, type, bounds_mm in spread coordinates (origin top left of the spread), layer_name, layer_locked, locked, visible, text_length for text frames, links[] {link_id, file_name, status}}; spreads without pasteboard objects are left out. Also item_count, link_count, spreads_checked and coordinate_space "spread". Remove leftovers with delete_frame (by item_id) or delete_link (by link_id). Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_parent_pages.description: Also check the parent spreads (default false).

name: list_pasteboard_items
title: List objects on the pasteboard
